intro: This Algorithm Theoretical Basis Document (ATBD) comprehensively details the technical framework for producing the Copernicus Protected Areas Land Cover/Land Use (LC/LU) product for 2021 and 2024. It outlines the methodologies used to generate harmonised, high-quality data for terrestrial Natura 2000 sites across the EU27. The document focuses on the semi-automatic workflow, integrating super-resolved Sentinel-2 imagery and diverse CLMS datasets within a bioregional deep learning approach, complemented by rigorous post-processing and manual refinement to ensure robust thematic and geometric accuracy.
